test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which sector in India saw significant growth due to globalisation and outsourcing after the 1990s?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IT and Services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India witnessed a significant transformation in the **IT and Services sector** post-globalisation in the 1990s.
 
• Globalisation and **outsourcing** enabled Indian companies to access international markets and cater to global clients.
 
• The liberalisation policies of the Indian Government in **1991** opened up the economy, allowing foreign investments and boosting this sector.
 
• The advancement in **technology**, especially in telecommunications and the internet, played a pivotal role in the growth of IT and Services.
 
• India became a hub for **IT-enabled services (ITES), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)**, attracting clients from the US, UK, and other developed nations.
 
• Availability of a large pool of highly skilled and English-speaking professionals helped India establish itself as a global leader in IT and Services.
 
• Major cities like **Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, and Chennai** emerged as IT hubs, hosting multinational companies such as **Infosys, TCS, Wipro, and HCL**.
 
• The sector contributed significantly to India's **GDP** and continues to be a major source of employment and foreign exchange earnings.
 
• India’s IT and Services industry is supported by organisations like **NASSCOM** which promote and facilitate growth in this field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Agriculture**__

 __
 
• **Agriculture** is one of the primary sectors of the Indian economy and employs a significant portion of the population.
 
• Despite its importance, agriculture did not experience the same level of growth as the IT and Services sector due to globalisation and outsourcing.
 
• Challenges such as dependency on monsoons, lack of modernisation, and small land holdings hindered its rapid growth during the globalisation era.
 
 
 
• **Mining**__
 __
 
• **Mining** is crucial for extracting minerals and resources, contributing to industrial development.
 
• While mining saw some growth post-globalisation, the sector did not benefit as significantly as IT and Services due to limited technological advancements and environmental concerns.
 
 
 
• **Real Estate**__
 
 
• The **Real Estate sector** expanded post-globalisation, driven by urbanisation and foreign direct investments.
 
• However, its growth was not as pronounced as the IT and Services sector due to dependency on domestic demand and regulatory challenges.
